assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and transient neurological deficits suggestive of transient cerebral ischemic attacks, occurring in the context of known paroxysmal atrial fibrillation.
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to correlate these symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias and to assess the efficacy of current rate and rhythm control strategies.
The documented indication for syncope is R55.
The documented indication for transient cerebral ischemic attacks is G45.9.
The patient has known paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0).
